sn46.36:1.1: “Bhikkhus, these seven factors of enlightenment, when developed and cultivated, lead to growth, to nondecline.
sn46.36:1.2: What seven? The enlightenment factor of mindfulness … the enlightenment factor of equanimity.
sn46.36:1.4: These seven factors of enlightenment, when developed and cultivated, lead to growth, to nondecline.”
